description: This file implements a client class for interacting with Google's Gemini API, including fallback mock responses when API keys are missing or API calls fail. It manages API configuration, handles generation of responses based on prompts and conversation history, and provides mock responses for testing.

classes.name: GeminiClient
classes.description: A client class for communicating with Google's Gemini API. Handles configuration, response generation, and fallback mock responses.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the Gemini client by attempting to configure the SDK with the API key or falling back to mock mode.

methods.name: str generate_response( self, prompt: str, history: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None )
methods.description: Generates a response to the given prompt, optionally using conversation history; switches to mock response if in mock mode or on error.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,str]] _format_history_for_gemini( self, history: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] )
methods.description: Converts internal message history format into Gemini API-compatible message format.

methods.name: str _generate_mock_response(self, prompt: str, error: bool = False)
methods.description: Provides a mock response in markdown format when API is unavailable or in mock mode.
